Sexmatch Roleplay Edition is the card game for couples in which you have to match illustrations and words by performing challenges until one of the two cards runs out.

The game contains 89 playing cards (81 cards and 8 wild) and 1 guide card.

Rules of the game:

  • To start the game, all 89 cards are shuffled and 7 cards are dealt to each player. The rest of the cards are left face-down on the table forming the draw deck. The oldest player starts by randomly drawing the first card. Next it is the turn of the other player, he must draw a card that matches in illustration or word with the card on the table. If you have no valid card, you must take a card from the deck of the draw and lose your turn.
  • Each time a player rolls a card that matches the previous one on the table, he must perform the action that marks the card at that very moment.

Wild cards:

  • There are also 8 wild cards, 2 of each type. The player who has a wild card in his hand can cast it during his turn at any time during the game. When a player rolls the wild card, the other player must perform the action indicated on the wild card at that time.
  • After the wild card is thrown, the player who throws it must indicate a word and an illustration and the other player can throw one or the other at his convenience to continue the game.

The player who runs out of cards first wins the game. The person who wins the game decides which type of massage from all those who have appeared in the illustrations during the game is the one he or she wants to receive from his or her partner.

Enjoy the game together in which making Sexmatch has very sexy rewards!

  • The cards are available in 8 languages: Spanish, English, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian and Polish.
